note: Typical-technology benchmark figures for efficiency context only. Never a verdict on a specific appliance.

washer.unit_note: Benchmark 0.5 kWh/cycle is consistent with the Israeli 2024 average 0.55 (ynet); the EC page gives the eco 40-60 label methodology (kWh per 100 cycles), it is not the source of the figure. Program and temperature change consumption materially

sources.label: European Commission - washing machines energy label (consumption per 100 cycles, eco 40-60)
Israeli Ministry of Energy market study via ynet: 0.93 kWh/cycle (2021) vs 0.55 (2024), -41%

ac.unit_note: Range across studies for inverter vs on/off room AC: 11-38% (Istanbul field test), ~24% (Saudi Arabia 1989: measured single-speed unit vs simulated inverter), ~44% (Jeddah)

sources.label: Istanbul Technical University field test: inverter saves 11-38%
KFUPM 1989 (ASHRAE Transactions): measured single-speed unit vs simulated inverter; inverter used 24% less energy
